rationale: The agent executed order-changing actions (cancelling two pending orders and initiating returns) without first confirming each action with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm before writes. Authentication was not clearly performed beyond a lookup by one email, with no explicit verification. The user’s nuanced constraint about keeping/exchanging the boots only if a cheaper identical pair exists was not addressed or confirmed. The agent also chose a gift card refund method without documented user consent and did not provide a clear final summary of how much money the user could get back today. Therefore, despite using tools to fetch user and order details, the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
